name: 1.22.0-beta.13
notes: Find variants: new experimental switch “Keep whole objects together”. A small AI (MobileSAM) looks at each picture to see where objects end, so an edge shared by versions goes into each object's own layer instead of becoming a separate layer you have to turn on with them.
The AI runs on this device; nothing is sent anywhere. It downloads about 33 MB the first time it's used, then works offline. It makes Find variants slower, especially on phones.
